title: 逢雪宿芙蓉山主人
author: 刘长卿

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Poem (semantic reference only, no printed text): 逢雪宿芙蓉山主人 — 刘长卿
日暮苍山远，天寒白屋贫。
柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人。
